Your move-in checklist ↗
THE FIELD NOTES / 001

Find the place.
Know the details.

A great apartment is more than a great photo.
Here’s what to check before calling it home.

UIUC housing search guide ↗
01 / THE REAL NUMBER

Rent is just the start.

Add utilities, parking, internet, and required fees. Check whether the price is per bedroom or for the whole apartment.

02 / THE EVERYDAY ROUTE

Walk your tomorrow.

Look up your actual classroom or workplace. Check the bus route and visit the neighborhood at different times.

03 / THE FINE PRINT

See it. Then sign it.

Tour the exact unit, ask what’s included, and read the lease. A photo gallery isn’t a promise of availability.

04 / YOUR PEOPLE

Make room for real life.

Discuss shared costs and routines with roommates. University apartments have eligibility rules—check before applying.
